newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies eight issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies eight issues for bond insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said Monday it qualified for bond insurance the following eight municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today:
--Allen Parish School District No 5, La., $3.5 million GOs school bonds.
--Baraga County, Mich., $1.5 million GOs jail bonds.
--Forest Park School District, Mich., $7.13 million school bonds.
--Marcellus Community School District, Mich., $3.53 million GOs.
--Otto Eldred School District, Pa., $4.39 million GOs, alternate bidding.
--Mansfield, Texas, $2.3 million water and sewer bonds.
